rules.statement: The appellant cannot now be heard to say that the real amount was larger and thereby admit that the revenue was defrauded of the duty due on the excess, as it had paid duty on the bond on a different footing.
rules.supporting_quote: Their Lordships are clearly of opinion that the appellant, having paid duty on the bond on the footing that it was only for Rs. 10,504.79 of existing debt, cannot now be heard, by maintaining another construction, to say that the real amount was larger and to thereby admit that the revenue was defrauded of the duty due on the excess.
